answers.core: Squircle implementation gives more control over how UIs look and allows achieving a quite common effect that is already available in [the most popular UI-prototyping software](https://www.userinterviews.com/ux-research-software-report-2023). Also squircles have already been mentioned in the previous issues here https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/10932 https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/3494
answers.workaround: You can implement squircles using shaders but that's quite an advanced feature.
